description: This file defines the EBSClient class used for interacting with Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS), extending the AwsClient class and including method annotations for EBS operations.

classes.name: EBSClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon EBS service, extending the core AwsClient.

methods.name: completeSnapshot
methods.description: Completes a snapshot operation for EBS.

methods.name: getSnapshotBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a block from a snapshot.

methods.name: listChangedBlocks
methods.description: Lists changed blocks within a snapshot.

methods.name: listSnapshotBlocksAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists blocks in a snapshot.

methods.name: putSnapshotBlock
methods.description: Uploads a block to a snapshot.
